subject: mathematics
instructions: Work independently. Show the mathematical steps or representation that support each response.
Check each result before submitting. A response without the requested work may require adult review.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain translations rotations reflections and dilations in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of coordinate rules.
Apply congruence through rigid motion in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving similarity through dilation; correct it and explain why.
Connect translations rotations reflections and dilations with informal geometric arguments. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Create a transformation-based design and prove selected figures congruent or similar.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.

Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
